title: Novel cerium(IV)-diolate complex with a 13-nuclear cerium(IV)-oxo core: Synthesis, molecular structure and catalytic property for ε-caprolactone-polymerization

synthesis.procedure: Under argon (Schlenk), tBuONa in THF (about 7.0 mL, 7.917 mmol) was added by syringe to a suspension of (NH4)2Ce(NO3)6 (1.089 g, 1.986 mmol) in 25 mL THF at 0 °C. The mixture was stirred at 0 °C for 0.5 h, then warmed to room temperature and stirred for 24 h. A THF solution of N-phenyldiethanolamine (0.362 g, 2.00 mmol) was added, and stirring was continued for another 24 h. After centrifugation, the clear solution was concentrated to about 6 mL and transferred into four glass tubes (ca. 5 mm diameter). A THF solution of 1,10-phenanthroline was layered over the cerium solution. Yellow crystals of Ce(NO3)3(phen)2 formed immediately in the upper layer. The tubes were kept still vertically at 40 °C, and red crystals of 1 formed gradually over several weeks (0.176 g, 0.034 mmol, 22.2% based on Ce).
synthesis.time: 0.5 h at 0 °C, 24 h at room temperature after tBuONa, then 24 h after ligand addition; crystals of 1 over several weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques under argon; centrifugation; layered crystallization in glass tubes
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifugation to a clear solution, concentration to ~6 mL, transfer into four ~5 mm glass tubes, overlay with THF/phen; yellow Ce(NO3)3(phen)2 crystals form immediately in the upper layer; red crystals of 1 grow from the solution at 40 °C over several weeks.

synthesis.procedure: Isolated from the same Schlenk reaction used for complex 1: after concentrating the THF reaction mixture and layering with a THF solution of 1,10-phenanthroline, yellow crystals of Ce(NO3)3(phen)2 formed immediately in the upper layer (0.820 g, 1.195 mmol, 60.2% based on Ce).
synthesis.temperature: layering at ambient conditions after room-temperature reaction; tubes later held at 40 °C
synthesis.time: yellow crystals formed immediately upon layering
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques under argon; layered crystallization in glass tubes
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Clear concentrated THF solution layered with THF/phen; yellow crystals formed immediately in the upper layer.
